Name: Mizu's Capybara
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Need a happy buddy to chill on your farm with you? Maybe someone to help you with fishing? This mod is for you if you like all things about capybara! It adds capybara as a new [b]barn [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Capybara find a variety of[b] river forage, trash,[/b] and [b]fishing tackle[/b]! They're great for people who want a passive way of getting lures and recyclables.[/*]
[*]Two cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller.[/b] [/*]
[*]Capybara are a tropical treasure! [b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you unlock [b]Ginger Island[/b] and complete the [b]Special Order: A Course on Capybara.[/b] [/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to drop a variety of items.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 2 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ capybara meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
